name: a100_lite
description: A stripped NVIDIA A100-class SM (GA100, Ampere, sm_80), one SM with its 1/108 share of the chip's L2 and HBM bandwidth: 64-bit integer and addresses with an FP32-only FPU (RV64IMAF, FLEN 32), VM, atomics with CAS, L2, an Ampere tensor core (FP16/BF16, TF32, INT8, INT4, 2:4 sparse), MUFU; no FP64, no graphics, no DXA/DMA, no WGMMA. One Vortex core per SM, four compute slices per core (one per SM partition). The a100_lite_m<n> profiles are the same SM at n SMs with the memory system scaled to n.

sources.inherited (a100): 64 warps x 32 threads, 4 schedulers; 1410 MHz; HBM2 at GPGPU-Sim SM80_A100's DRAM latency and queue
sources.XLEN 64, VM, A + ZACAS, ZFHMIN: 64-bit addresses, unified virtual memory, atomicCAS; FP16 load/store/convert
sources.EXT_D off (FLEN 32): milestone choice: the A100's 32 FP64 units per SM (8 per partition) and its FP64 tensor-core path (DMMA) are left out; FP32-only FPU on a 64-bit core (RV64IMAF, ABI lp64f)
sources.FETCH_WIDTH 4, NUM_SFU_BLOCKS 4: 4 SM partitions (processing blocks), each its own warp scheduler and dispatch: four compute slices per core
sources.ALU/FPU lanes 16: 64 FP32 + 64 INT32 cores per SM = 16 per partition (A100 whitepaper, Fig. 7); a 32-thread warp issues over two 16-lane packets, as on Ampere
sources.FDIV_PE_RATIO 16, FSQRT_PE_RATIO 16: the SM has no per-lane divide or square-root units (CUDA C++ Programming Guide, arithmetic instruction throughput, cc 8.0: division and square root are multi-instruction sequences on the SFU and FMA pipes); one shared divider and one square-root unit per partition (16 FPU lanes / 16)
sources.FCVT_PE_RATIO 4: type conversions at 16 results/clk/SM (CUDA C++ Programming Guide throughput table, cc 8.0: 16 per SM per clock for 32-bit conversions), i.e. 4 per partition (16 FPU lanes / 4)
sources.LSU lanes 32 (default = NUM_THREADS): the A100 has 8 LD/ST units per partition, but Vortex requires NUM_TCU_LANES == NUM_THREADS (VX_tcu_block, full-warp execution) and NUM_TCU_LANES == NUM_LSU_LANES for sparse metadata loads (VX_tcu_agu), so LSU stays 32
sources.LMEM_NUM_BANKS 16: shared memory at 128 B/clk/SM (A100 whitepaper: 32 banks x 4 B): 16 banks x 8 B words (XLEN 64) carry the same bytes per clock
sources.TCU lanes 32 (default = NUM_THREADS): forced by VX_tcu_block (see above); one tensor core per partition as on GA100
sources.MUFU 4 lanes: 4 SFUs per SM partition (16 per SM), A100 whitepaper Fig. 7
sources.TCU formats: 3rd-gen tensor cores: FP16 and BF16 (Vortex's FP16 path carries both), TF32, INT8, INT4, 2:4 structured sparsity; no FP8/FP4/MX/NVFP4 (Hopper/Blackwell), no WGMMA (Hopper)
sources.DXA, DMA off: Ampere has no TMA; the cp.async LDGSTS path has no Vortex equivalent beyond plain loads
sources.TEX, RASTER, OM, RTU off: GA100 has no RT cores or display/graphics pipeline in its compute SKU
sources.DCACHE 128 KB + LMEM 64 KB: 192 KB unified L1/shared per SM (whitepaper); Vortex keeps them separate and caps LMEM at 64 KB for XLEN 64 (VX_mem_unit asserts LMEM_BASE_ADDR = STACK_BASE 0x1FFFF0000 is aligned to the LMEM size, which only holds up to 64 KB), so the split is 128 KB L1D + 64 KB shared instead of the A100's up to 164 KB shared
sources.DCACHE 8-way, MSHR 24 per bank: kept from rtx5080_full for a like-for-like Foldsim comparison (A100 L1 associativity not published)
sources.ICACHE 128 KB, 16-way: per-SM L1 instruction cache class size used for the A100-faithful study
sources.memory scaled with the SMs (rule): n SMs get the chip's n/108 share: L2_NUM_BANKS = PLATFORM_MEMORY_NUM_BANKS = min(n, 32), powers of two (the a100 profile's 32 at full scale); L2_SIZE ~0.3 MiB per SM (32 MiB / 108) rounded to a power of two, the full 32 MiB from 64 SMs; PLATFORM_MEMORY_PEAK_BW = 1555000 x n / 108 MB/s; PLATFORM_MEMORY_DATA_RATE = PEAK_BW / (banks x 16 B) MT/s, so the modelled channels deliver PEAK_BW (the DRAM model's bandwidth is banks x 16 B x data rate; PEAK_BW alone is only reported to the runtime). The array timing is in nanoseconds, so latency is unchanged
sources.L2 256 KB, 1 bank, 16-way, MSHR 192; 1 H: 1 SM by the rule above; 16 ways and MSHR 192 per slice from GPGPU-Sim SM80_A100 dl2
